subject: add labels to item response category trace lines using itemplot()

messages.author: 9e35739f18a45ee9
messages.subject: add labels to item response category trace lines using itemplot()
parts:
Heya, is it possible to add labels to my trace lines when I use itemplot() on a GRM item (or NRM or whatever, for that matter)?  Right now they're auto-labeled P1, P2, P3, etc., but I'd like to put "disagree strongly", "disagree", "no opinion", etc.

Thanks!

Tyler

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: add labels to item response category trace lines using itemplot()
parts:
Not directly, but you can always edit the trellis objects until you get what you need. Something like the following works:

library(mirt)
pmod <- mirt(Science, 1)
plt <- itemplot(pmod, 3)
direct.label(plt, 'top.points')

# change labels
plt2 <- plt
plt2$panel.args.common$groups <- dplyr::recode(plt$panel.args.common$groups,
              P1 = "Lowest", P2 = "Low", P3 = "High", P4 = "Highest")
direct.label(plt2, 'top.points')

Phil
